conventions.origin: bottom centre / feet at y=0 (exceptions: island_base & dock_* origin = walk surface, parts go below 0)
conventions.forward: characters and props face +Z in glTF (Blender -Y); Babylon loader __root__ handles handedness
conventions.shading: flat palette colours, one PBR material per palette entry (roughness 0.85, metallic 0), no textures/UVs; materials named pal_<colour> are identical across files → share/dedupe in engine
conventions.animations: characters: glTF animation groups per action, 30 fps, loops except cheer
